additional_info.subject: Y2/T2314142728001 - Install Precondition certificate - VAS Communication
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Team,
following my conversation with one of your support colleagues regarding the VAS installation, I’m sending this E-Mail. We have a Siemens Sicharge D (2 × 160 kW) charging station
Serial number: Y2/T2314142728001
installed at our depot in Hamburg, Germany.
We would like to install the VAS certificate on the charger and activate the VAS functionality, so that our buses can use preconditioning. (please find the certificate in the attachment)
Could you please configure and activate VAS on the charger? Let me know if you need any further information from our side.
Thank you in advance for your support!
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Saajid Rameez

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0476388-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2/T2314142728001] Install Precondition certificate - VAS Communication CRM:03056001005
additional_info.body:
Dear Saajid.
We have looked into this request and that feature that you refer to (VAS - Preconditioning) is still under development for sicharge R&D.
According to PM roadmap this feature will be released with FW update 9.x
We will be happy to support you with the integration of the charger with VAS once the feature is available.
Kidn regards
Catalina Mora
